title: Get GPT partition label (PARTLABEL)
summary: Retrieve the label assigned to a GPT partition entry. This label is stored in the partition table and is independent of the filesystem.

steps.explain: Use lsblk to print only the PARTLABEL for the specified device.

placeholders.name: DEVICE
placeholders.description: The block device path, e.g., sda1

steps.explain: Alternatively, use blkid to print only the PARTLABEL value.
